groups.label: Translator Paratext & Editions
groups.summary: Covers publication notes, academic dedications, and collaborators assisting Jowett's translation. It also outlines the substantial revisions in the third edition, exchange terms for existing owners, and intentions for subsequent dialogue publications.
groups.rationale: All six leaves belong to the opening front matter and editorial prefaces regarding the third edition translation and its administrative details.

groups.label: Philosophic Training & Decline
groups.summary: Examines the pedagogical role of mathematics and the corrupting perils of premature dialectical questioning among youth. It connects these philosophical abstractions to the mathematical cycles governing human generations and the theoretical ordering of political degeneration.
groups.rationale: These entries address the intellectual disciplines of the guardian curriculum alongside the abstract numerical and theoretical principles governing social decay.

groups.label: Poetry Critique & Cosmic Myth
groups.summary: Discusses Plato's reservations toward imitative poetry in the cultural context of his era versus ideal art. It also analyzes the cosmological architecture and mythological mechanisms in the Vision of Er.
groups.rationale: Both items evaluate Plato's symbolic and imaginative frameworks, analyzing his critical handling of poetry and his mythic astronomical allegory.

groups.label: Institutions of the Ideal State
groups.summary: Investigates the constitutional foundations and historical models of Plato's state, highlighting Dorian, Spartan, and Pythagorean roots. It details core radical proposals, including communal property, the abolition of private families, and the suppression of individual genius.
groups.rationale: These entries form a coherent thematic sequence exploring the institutional models, philosophical paradoxes, and historical comparisons that underpin the ideal polity.
